reviewMethod: Actually opened both saved output PNGs using view_image, after immediate copy into the repository. Comparison is visual, not pixel-perfect registration validation. PNG dimensions and SHA-256 also read locally.

visualChecks.identityContinuity: pass at concept level: left vine low-left leaf/high-right fan and right vine large right leaf cluster retain order, form and pale binding vocabulary. No obvious added vine or increased crop.
visualChecks.oldVineAndDeadBranch: pass: original old vine, live upper bud, hanging brown dead leaves and branch stay on left in both states.
visualChecks.fixedScene: pass at concept level: center gutter, two plots, stone walls, tall trellis and path footprints persist. Some generated texture/pixel drift remains; not a registered production patch.
visualChecks.unblockedPublicPaths: pass: broad dry path outside each plot remains open; no forced passage through plot or dwelling.
visualChecks.buriedYoungRoots: pass: young stems enter soil, no exposed young-root fan or active uprooting scene. Old vine surface roots are retained as established old-vine visual, not a relocation technique.
visualChecks.noFruitOrYieldRecovery: pass: no grapes, harvested fruit or abundance cue.
visualChecks.noEvictionOrOwnershipTransfer: pass: no people, homes, flags or land-transfer event.
visualChecks.style: pass concept-level hard pixel clusters, muted earth/grey/wood/green palette.

caveats: Initial requested exact tie-turn count and three-leaf second-vine shape were not reproduced literally: both before plants have forked silhouettes and multiple leaf/bud clusters. Accepted as two distinguishable construction proposals, then continuity preserved into the second image. Counts do not define canonical inventory.
No exact palette quantization, tile grid, collisions, engineering horticulture, in-engine render or runtime state transition was validated.
All consent/feasibility/permission/compensation-or-valid-installments/risk-sharing/actual-relocation guards remain external prerequisites; neither image proves them.
No correction run required because the actual source-bound relocation/count/invariant requirements visibly hold.
